Dataset Information

Source: vignettes/datasets.Rmd
datasets.Rmd

The following table shows the non-simulated data sets in this package, along with a short description and the use-case of the data sets. These data sets are used the textbook Foundations of Spatial Statistics (working title) by Matt Higham and Michael Dumelle (Taylor & Francis CRC Press, August 2027).

For any data sets used, please cite the original source of the data (found in Source and/or References in at the bottom of the help page ?name_of_data_set). Thank you in advance for giving proper credit to those who have collected and/or curated this data!

Many of these data sets can be analyzed using functions from the spmodel R package: https://usepa.github.io/spmodel/ (citation below).

Dumelle M, Higham M, Ver Hoef JM (2023). spmodel: Spatial statistical modeling and prediction in R. PLOS ONE 18(3): e0282524. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0282524.


Datasets used in the Foundations of Spatial Statistics textbook (Higham and Dumelle, to be published August 2027).
name purpose description
acapori Point Patterns Acapori Trees in Plot 6 of the Paracou Research Station in French Guiana.
alfalfa Geostatistics (Normal Errors) Alfalfa Yield in Saudi Arabia.
anemones_sf Point Patterns Anemone Locations in France.
baltimore_housing Geostatistics (Normal Errors) Sale Prices for Homes in Baltimore, Maryland in 1978 (sf).
baltimore_housing_df Geostatistics (Normal Errors) Sale Prices for Homes in Baltimore, Maryland in 1978 (tibble).
clement_hits Geostatistics (Normal Errors) Hitting Data for Ernie Clement in the 2025 Season through the End of June.
clement_swings Spatial Logistic Swing Data for Ernie Clement in the 2025 Season through the End of June.

in_high Geostatistics (Normal Errors) Data on High Schools in Indiana (United States).

kakaralli Point Patterns Kakaralli Trees in Plot 6 of the Paracou Research Station in French Guiana.

ohio_cancer_point Spatial Poisson/NBinom Lung Cancer Cases in Ohio Counties (point).

yamamoto_pitches Point Patterns Pitching Data for Yoshinobu Yamamoto in June of 2026 (June 1 through June 25).
